status: 4-1 complete: phone sample verification and v1 format decision
transport: USB adb reverse to Windows 127.0.0.1:8766, Cache-Control no-store, sequential fetch; not CDN or mobile network

decision.reason: All 27 input checks passed. 0.02 uses 6–9 files versus 20–30 for 0.01; avoids the larger transfer/processing cost of 0.04. 0.01 was faster for the boundary sample, so 0.02 is not claimed fastest everywhere.

limitations: One physical phone, debug native shell + production JS, USB charging and sequential order without randomized repeats; not a release-app or low-memory-device performance guarantee.

Total includes benchmark-only merged-input SHA-256 and yield scheduling, excludes manifest/case-list retrieval and route search. decode includes hash/gunzip/UTF-8/JSON/schema checks; phase medians must not be added.
PSS/RSS include the whole app and native runtime. Snapshots cover each full interval but can miss instantaneous peaks, are not JS heap or road-only memory, and sampling overhead is not isolated.
Phone verifies full merged-input SHA-256 and graph node/edge counts; PC previously verified every graph link and all route candidates.
Only three public samples and radius 2km. No national coverage, operational CDN/network benchmark, permanent cache integration, maximum file-size stress, low-end-device or outdoor tests.
Application identity and data-directory inode were preserved by update installs; private database bytes were not extracted or compared.
